core_categories: E-commerce; Specialty Retail; Health and Wellness; Sports Nutrition; Vitamins and Supplements
specialty_focus: HealthKart is an omni-channel health and wellness marketplace and direct-to-consumer brand house in India, operating an online platform, mobile app, and physical retail stores. It specializes in sports nutrition, bodybuilding supplements, vitamins, and fitness products, and owns in-house brands like MuscleBlaze and HK Vitals. It does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
key_brands: MuscleBlaze, HK Vitals, TrueBasics, FuelOne, Gritzo, others
